attributes.title: CAMFT Annual Conference 2027
attributes.cme_provider: California Association of Marriage and Family Therapists
attributes.organizer: California Association of Marriage and Family Therapists
attributes.summary:
CAMFT is recognized by the California Board of Behavioral Sciences as a CE provider for LMFTs, LEPs, LPCCs and LCSWs, which makes this meeting simple to map to a California renewal. Earlier editions offered about 20 hours over two days, so one trip can cover a good share of a cycle.

Only the dates and San Francisco are public so far. Venue, program and 2027 fees are not published; CAMFT is collecting names for early-rate notices on its save-the-date page, and early access has opened months ahead in past years.
